patch.value: Send acknowledged Beads changes as compact field operations

Generate field operations between two acknowledged Beads snapshots, with explicit removals, source/base digests and a full-snapshot fallback when the base is unavailable. Acceptance: two changed fields among 1,000 records emit exactly two operations plus identity receipts; replay is a no-op; an incorrect base refuses without altering either side. Include typed SDK and CLI, strict bounded validation, property tests, no-git public tracker measurements and npm/Bun CI evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: core SDK history and certified complete reads provide revisions and tracker data; Beads reconciliation consumes full snapshots; pending transfer preserves dependency closure; pm-vcs storage and pm-csv import own different boundaries. None supplies acknowledged outbound field operations. Design: a pure, bounded snapshot protocol reuses Beads acknowledgements and existing normalization, emits explicit unset/remove operations and source/base/target receipts, reconstructs a full snapshot before existing reconciliation. No new mutable outbox, lease, checkpoint or tracker mutation path.
